# Miriam's Unbound Style Start Menu

[![pokeemerald-expansion](https://img.shields.io/badge/pokeemerald--expansion-upcoming-blue?style=flat-square&logo=github)](https://github.com/rh-hideout/pokeemerald-expansion/)
![Status Alpha](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-alpha-red?style=flat-square)

This is a feature branch implementing a graphical start menu inspired by the one
from Pokémon Unbound.
It uses sprites for start menu entries and is meant to be easily extensible so
users can change the icons, or add new items.

## Features

- Rearrange icons freely during gameplay.
- Compatible with the Day Night System in expansion.
- Handles flash darkness properly.
- Easily extensible should you want to add more items.
